facts.sourceName: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
facts.text: OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA).
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page lists AU$587 for the full test and US$455 in the USA; no rupee amount appears

facts.sourceName: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
facts.text: Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page lists the single sub-test fees for the paper test

facts.text: Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the overview marks Listening and Reading as common and Writing and Speaking as profession-specific

facts.text: The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives 45 minutes with 5 of reading time and a profession-specific letter from case notes

facts.text: The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives about 20 minutes and two profession-specific role-plays of 5 minutes

facts.text: Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives the 0 to 500 scale, grades A to E and B = 350

facts.text: OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page states a 6-calendar-day aim (met in 95% of cases) for the computer test and OET@Home

facts.text: Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives 12 days for the paper test

facts.text: OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page leaves validity to the recognising body

facts.text: A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives the search-and-book route and the three formats

facts.text: Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives the 24-day and 7-day closing rules

facts.text: On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the regulations list passport and national ID with these conditions

facts.sourceName: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date?
facts.text: A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after.
facts.whatSupportsIt: the page gives the two-day limit and the AU$120 and AU$200 fees
